top_signals.title: Liquid Network pauses after purported ‘white-hat’ hackers withdraw $320 million in bitcoin
top_signals.summary: The Bitcoin sidechain has been paused, with exchanges suspending LBTC deposits and withdrawals as Blockstream works to contact those responsible.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Ryuichi Sakamoto’s final memoir lays bare a maestro’s final questions
top_signals.summary: The late composer's memoir, translated into English by Sam Bett, details his early life, fascination with music, career highlights and musings on time and life.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
